summary: Iteration 295 - PMS Pro Module Tests Complete. Backend: 26/26 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All 4 PMS Pro tabs (Smart Assign, AI Concierge, Journey Rules, Anomaly Alerts) working correctly with full CRUD operations and AI integration.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 295 PMS Pro module tests completed. All 26 backend API tests passed. Tested endpoints: (1) POST /api/pms-pro/smart-assign - AI room assignment with scoring based on room type, floor preference, quiet, accessibility, capacity, maintenance status, and past complaints. Returns best_room, best_score, best_reasons, top_candidates. (2) POST /api/pms-pro/ai-concierge - Natural language Turkish queries with intent classification (arrivals/departures/vip/maintenance/housekeeping) and GPT-4o-mini summary. Uses real Emergent LLM Key. (3) GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /api/pms-pro/journey-rules - Full CRUD for guest journey automation rules with triggers (booking_confirmed, pre_arrival_24h, etc.) and actions (send_email, send_sms, etc.). (4) GET /api/pms-pro/anomalies/{property_id} - Operational alerts for VIP arrivals, no-show risk, stale maintenance, housekeeping backlog, blocked arrivals. RBAC: Smart Assign, AI Concierge, and Anomalies allow admin/manager/receptionist. Journey Rules only allow admin/manager (receptionist gets 403). Frontend: PMS Pro panel accessible via OPERATIONS > PMS Pro (AI ops) in sidebar. All 4 tabs render correctly with proper data-testid attributes. Smart Assign shows room recommendations with scores and reasons. AI Concierge shows chat interface with suggestion buttons and Turkish AI responses. Journey Rules shows table with toggle/delete actions and add form. Anomaly Alerts shows alert cards with level badges (info/warning/critical) and refresh button.
